citation: Gray, D. F. and Nagel, T. 1989, The granulation boundary in the H-R diagram, ApJ 341, 421
note: A boundary runs from G1 Ib to near F0 on the main sequence; cooler stars show classical granulation bisectors, hotter stars reversed ones; Abstract supports no classical granulation hotter than about F0. On the hot side it reports a different, possibly faster, velocity field, not none.
